text: Cadet! The stores truck is here. We load everything with the provision crane.
With the crane? Can I help?
Yes. I'm in the crane, you're the signalman. You watch the load and give me the signals.
Diego, before the first lift, check the gear: the sling, the shackle and the hook.
Sling on the hook, shackle pin tight. Ready.
OK, cadet. Give me the signals.
Hoist slowly… Stop!
Where does it go?
Slew left… Stop. Lower… lower… Stop. Load on deck.
Careful! My eggs are in that pallet!
Relax, Mario. Cadet, now we lash it. Lashings on, turnbuckles tight.
Lashings on, turnbuckles tight. Nothing moves.
Good work, you two. Next pallet: the drinks.
Show me the hook.
Where's the pad eye?
Where's the snatch block?
Show me the thimble.
Show me the turnbuckle.
Where's the jib?
Where does it go, cadet?
Cadet, the load is ready. Give me the signal.
Diego, is the gear ready?
Is the pallet secure?
Rolando, what are you lifting now?
I'm lifting the vegetables.
Next pallet: the frozen meat.
The load must go to the left. Give me the signal.
